method: Matched every almanac entity to serialized Android4.1 data by scoped PlantType/ZombieType enum. Compared direct HP, armor, base damage and attack intervals, checked source/English numeric differences, traced native exceptions. Specialized effects are not inferred from unrelated base fields. This is a static description audit, not exhaustive combat testing.
